Item.Label: Goal Type

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp boolean;
 temp1 varchar2(5);
begin
nullchk; check_package_failure;

select 'temp' into temp1 
from valid_master_codes 
where code = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type and
 code_type = 'GOALS'and
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

:ctrl_block_1.Custodian := null ;
:ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian := null ;

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'INGOL' then
 select inst_short_name,inst_id 
 into :ctrl_block_1.Custodian ,:ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian
 from institutions 
 where sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.Custodian',navigable,PROPERTY_FALSE);
elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FXGOL' then
 :ctrl_block_1.Custodian := 'Fixed Goal' ;
 :ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian := 'FXGOL' ;
elsif :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'FLGOL' then
 :ctrl_block_1.Custodian := 'Field Goal' ;
 :ctrl_block_1.G_Custodian := 'FLGOL' ;
else
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.Custodian',enabled,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.Custodian',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
end if;

exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11247');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
temp number :=0 ;
begin
if :system.trigger_item is null then
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
end if ;

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type is null then
 show_error('11247');
 check_package_failure;

end if; 


begin

if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'SPGOL' then
 begin
 select sponsor_id into :g_custodian from sponsors 
 where upper(name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if;
if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TRGOL' then
 begin
 select territory_id into :g_custodian from valid_territories where 
 upper(territory_short_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if;
if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'STGOL' then
 begin
 select site_id into :g_custodian
 from fixed_sites a, locations b where a.site_id = b.location_id and
 upper(b.location_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if;
if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'RECTR' then
 begin
 select staff_no into :g_custodian
 from employees where upper(first_name||' '||last_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and emp_class='RECRT' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if;
if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'TELRC' then
 begin
 select staff_no into :g_custodian
 from employees where upper(first_name||' '||last_name) = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and emp_class='TELRC' and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if;
if :ctrl_block_1.goal_type = 'DNGOL' then
 begin
 select donors.donor_id into :g_custodian
 from donors,donor_interdictions donint 
 where donors.donor_id=donint.donor_id 
 and first_name||' '||last_name = :ctrl_block_1.custodian
 and donors.chapter_id=:global.chapter_id 
 and donint.inter_code='DGOAL' 
 and donint.chapter_id = donors.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('11303');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
end if;


end;
end;

begin
 if :s_goals.don_desc is not null then
 select donation_type, description 
 into :s_goals.donation_type, :s_goals.don_desc 
 from valid_donation_types 
 where ( rtrim( upper( description )) = rtrim( upper( :s_goals.don_desc )) 
 or donation_type = rtrim( upper( :s_goals.don_desc )))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

exception

 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 temp := show_lov( 'LOV_DONTYPE' );
 if not temp then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 when others then
 handle_error;
end;

PROCEDURE create_daily_goals IS
 t number;
BEGIN
-- create_record; 

SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('goals',insert_allowed,property_true);

 for t in 0..:ctrl_block_1.end_date - :ctrl_block_1.start_date loop

 if check_day_click then
 if SUBSTR(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t,'DAY'),1,3) = 'MON' and
 :ctrl_block_1.mon = 'Y' then
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t);
 elsif substr(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t,'DAY'),1,3) = 'TUE' and
 :ctrl_block_1.tue = 'Y' then
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t);
 elsif SUBSTR(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t,'DAY'),1,3) = 'WED' and
 :ctrl_block_1.wed = 'Y'then
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t);
 elsif SUBSTR(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t,'DAY'),1,3) = 'THU' and
 :ctrl_block_1.thu = 'Y'then
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t);
 elsif SUBSTR(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t,'DAY'),1,3) = 'FRI' and
 :ctrl_block_1.fri = 'Y'then
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t);
 elsif SUBSTR(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t,'DAY'),1,3) = 'SAT' and
 :ctrl_block_1.sat = 'Y'then
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t);
 elsif SUBSTR(to_char(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t,'DAY'),1,3) = 'SUN' and
 :ctrl_block_1.sun = 'Y'then
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t);
 end if; 
 else
 copy_data(:ctrl_block_1.start_date+t); 
 end if; 
 check_package_failure;
 end loop;
go_record(1);
-- SET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('goals',insert_allowed,property_FALSE);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: COPY_DATA

PROCEDURE copy_data (g_date IN date) IS
TEMP NUMBER;

BEGIN
 :ctrl_block_1.create_check := 'YES';

 go_block('s_goals'); 
 check_package_failure ;
 go_record(1);
 check_package_failure ;
 loop
 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 go_block('goals');
 if :goals.goal_start_date is not null then
 last_record;
 next_record;
 end if; 
 select count(*) into temp from goals where 
 TRUNC(goal_start_date) = TRUNC(G_DATE) and
 TRUNC(goal_end_date) = TRUNC(G_DATE) and
 donation_type = decode(:s_goals.don_desc,NULL,'NONE',:s_goals.donation_type) and 
 procedure_code = decode(:s_goals.type_desc,NULL,'NONE',:s_goals.procedure_code) and
 blood_type = decode(:s_goals.abo_desc,NULL,'NONE',:s_goals.blood_type)
 and goal_type = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type
 and goal_custodian = :ctrl_block_1.g_custodian;
 IF TEMP <= 0 THEN
 :goals.goal_start_date := g_date;
 :goals.goal_end_date := g_date;
 :goals.donation_type := :s_goals.donation_type;
 :goals.procedure_code := :s_goals.procedure_code;
 :goals.blood_type := :s_goals.blood_type;
 :goals.goal_count := :s_goals.goal_count;
 :goals.d_type := :s_goals.don_desc;
 :goals.p_code := :s_goals.type_desc;
 :goals.a_type := :s_goals.abo_desc;
 :goals.STS := 'NEW';
 if to_char(:goals.goal_start_date,'DAY') = to_char(:goals.goal_end_date,'DAY') then
 :goals.day := to_char(:goals.goal_start_date,'DAY');
 end if;
 END IF;
 exit;
 else
 go_block('goals');
 if :goals.goal_start_date is not null then
 last_record;
 next_record;
 end if;
 select count(*) into temp from goals where 
 TRUNC(goal_start_date) = TRUNC(G_DATE) and
 TRUNC(goal_end_date) = TRUNC(G_DATE) and
 donation_type = decode(:s_goals.don_desc,NULL,'NONE',:s_goals.donation_type) and 
 procedure_code = decode(:s_goals.type_desc,NULL,'NONE',:s_goals.procedure_code) and
 blood_type = decode(:s_goals.abo_desc,NULL,'NONE',:s_goals.blood_type)
 and goal_type = :ctrl_block_1.goal_type
 and goal_custodian = :ctrl_block_1.g_custodian ;
 IF TEMP <= 0 THEN
 :goals.goal_start_date := g_date;
 :goals.goal_end_date := g_date;
 :goals.donation_type := :s_goals.donation_type;
 :goals.procedure_code := :s_goals.procedure_code;
 :goals.blood_type := :s_goals.blood_type;
 :goals.goal_count := :s_goals.goal_count;
 :goals.d_type := :s_goals.don_desc;
 :goals.p_code := :s_goals.type_desc;
 :goals.a_type := :s_goals.abo_desc;
 :goals.STS := 'NEW';
 if to_char(:goals.goal_start_date,'DAY') = to_char(:goals.goal_end_date,'DAY') then
 :goals.day := to_char(:goals.goal_start_date,'DAY');
 end if;
 END IF;
 go_block('s_goals');
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
END;

if :ctrl_block_1.mon = 'N' and
